summary: Main table of basic stock information and static valuation. For valuation tasks, priority is given to obtaining name, industry, PE/PB/PS and market capitalization information from here.

structure.top_level_shape: Usually a small number of multi-version records are kept per strand or per source. There is no need to assume that there are nested multi-period arrays.

fallback_paths: If current_price is missing, prices are first obtained from market_quotes or get_latest_stock_price. Do not use stock_basic_info as the only source of real-time prices.
notes: For valuation tasks, it is preferred to use get_stock_valuation_context to uniformly obtain the current price and basic valuation indicators.

pitfalls: current_price Values may not exist or be up-to-date, and this collection should not be relied upon solely for real-time prices.
The same stock may retain multiple records by source, and priority needs to be considered when directly querying the collection.
